operations.name: Founder Travel Journal for 1975
operations.description: An entertaining, yet informative journal of the founder’s travel with parents while age 15 to London, France and Spain. The journal was the english class assignment for the founders favorite english teacher Mrs Mansfield at Palmetto Senior High School in Miami, Florida. The next year the founder attends Miami Southridge Senior High School as part of the first graduating class of 1978.
